fact: Ecofin Agency, citing an analysis published in May 2026, says Somalia has no officially adopted national AI strategy and no AI law; the as_of date is that analysis's month.

UN-ESCWA's terms of reference say the National Communication Authority asked ESCWA to help develop Somalia's national AI strategy and ESCWA is hiring a local consultant to draft it, for review at a national workshop.
Sombiz states that Somalia has no adopted AI strategy or policy, and that OECD.AI lists no AI policy initiative for the country.

The Somali National AI Center says the National Communications Authority, the communications ministry and Somali National University developed the Somalia National AI Strategy 2026-2030, which is still to be launched.
